title: Enhancing Bug Report Templates in the TianoCore UEFI Firmware Development Community
abstract: arXiv:2608.23754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose enhancing the bug report templates in the GitHub Issues issue tracking system used by the TianoCore open-source community with the aim of improving the bug triage and resolution process. We analyze the bug repository data and find patterns of information that are useful for bug triage and fixing. However, some of them are only occasionally included in the free-form text of bug reports. Therefore, we propose adding a few new fields to the existing TianoCore bug report template. In this study, we focus on the key TianoCore project, EDK II, which constitutes the core of the UEFI firmware across various firmware vendors and original equipment manufacturers. This study is currently a work-in-progress. So far, we have interviewed a few developers to obtain their feedback and adjust the proposed approach. translated_title: 在TianoCore UEFI固件开发社区中增强Bug报告模板
translated_abstract: 我们提议增强TianoCore开源社区使用的GitHub Issues问题跟踪系统中的Bug报告模板，旨在改进Bug分类和解决流程。我们分析了Bug仓库数据，发现了对Bug分类和修复有用的信息模式。然而，其中一些信息仅偶尔包含在Bug报告的自由文本中。因此，我们建议在现有的TianoCore Bug报告模板中添加几个新字段。在本研究中，我们聚焦于关键的TianoCore项目EDK II，该项目构成了各固件供应商和原始设备制造商UEFI固件的核心。本研究目前处于进行中阶段。迄今为止，我们已采访了几位开发者以获取反馈并调整所提议的方法。我们计划与TianoCore社区进行更多访谈，开展A/B测试并验证我们的方法以实现有效的结果。
tldr: 通过分析TianoCore EDK II的Bug数据，提出在Bug报告模板中添加新字段以改善Bug分类和修复效率。
en_tdlr: By analyzing TianoCore EDK II bug data, we propose adding new fields to the bug report template to improve bug triage and resolution efficiency.
